caption: Two skateboards glide across a smooth surface, seemingly propelled by an invisible force. The skateboard on the right, equipped with wheels, rolls effortlessly, maintaining a steady pace. In contrast, the skateboard on the left, lacking wheels, drags along the ground as friction takes its toll. The scene unfolds in a serene, sunlit setting, highlighting the contrasting dynamics of motion and resistance.
